items.title: From Stripe to Bitcoin: Card Fraud Case Ends in Prison Sentence

items.summary: Bitcoin's computational firepower, measured by its network hashrate, has reclaimed the 1 zettahash per second (ZH/s) threshold, with miners worldwide once again executing more than 1 sextillion calculations every second to safeguard the network and compete for newly minted bitcoin. items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

items.title: Bitcoin's wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
